name: Priciest Printing
postStartCommand: npm run build && setsid --fork npm run serve > /tmp/priciest-printing-server.log 2>&1 && (for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do if curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:4173/index.html -o /dev/null; then exit 0; fi; sleep 1; done; cat /tmp/priciest-printing-server.log; exit 1)
